description: Scrape books, authors, series, Listopia lists, popular shelves, and genres from Goodreads. Look up books by URL, search query, or ISBN.

authorUrls.description: Goodreads author URLs (e.g. https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/1077326). The actor walks /author/list/<id>?page=N for all books. (mode=auto, authors)
authorUrls.title: Author URLs

containsAuthor.description: Drop books unless one of their authors contains this substring (case-insensitive).
containsAuthor.title: Contains author

containsGenre.description: Drop books unless one of their genres contains this substring (case-insensitive).
containsGenre.title: Contains genre

includeMetadata.description: When true, emit one extra record per author/series/list with bio, description, and counts (recordType: 'author' | 'series' | 'list'). Default false.
includeMetadata.title: Include metadata records

isbns.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 codes. Goodreads' search redirects ISBN queries to the matching book. (mode=auto, isbns)
isbns.title: ISBNs

language.description: Drop books whose language doesn't contain this string (case-insensitive substring match). E.g. 'en', 'eng', 'English'.
language.title: Language

listUrls.description: Goodreads /list/show/ URLs (e.g. Best Books Ever). Paginated. (mode=auto, lists)
listUrls.title: Listopia list URLs

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total records emitted across all inputs. Books, search results, and listing-page results all count toward this.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Legacy field. Use maxItems instead. When set and maxItems is at its default, this value is used as the cap.
maxResultsPerQuery.title: [Deprecated] Max results per query

minRating.description: Drop books with averageRating below this integer threshold (0-5). For finer thresholds (e.g. 4.5), use a higher minRatingsCount filter to surface highly-rated books.
minRating.title: Min average rating

minRatingsCount.description: Drop books with fewer than N ratings.
minRatingsCount.title: Min ratings count

mode.description: What to scrape. Use 'auto' (default) to run any non-empty inputs you provide. Or pick a specific mode to run only that one.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. Goodreads is reachable from datacenter IPs without proxy; only enable if you hit sustained 429s.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

publishYearMax.description: Drop books published after this year.
publishYearMax.title: Published year max

publishYearMin.description: Drop books published before this year.
publishYearMin.title: Published year min

searchQueries.description: Free-text search terms (titles, authors, keywords). (mode=auto, search)
searchQueries.title: Search queries

seriesUrls.description: Goodreads series URLs (e.g. https://www.goodreads.com/series/49075-harry-potter). All books in the series are scraped. (mode=auto, series)
seriesUrls.title: Series URLs

shelfNames.description: Popular shelf names like 'mystery', 'fantasy', 'historical-fiction'. Paginated. (mode=auto, shelves)
shelfNames.title: Shelf names

title: Goodreads Scraper Input
